recognize_zh: CD3 染色下大量小至中型 T 細胞呈強棕色膜/質陽性，密集填滿結節，而夾雜其中的組織球與較大細胞為藍色陰性；豐富的 T 細胞背景是 T 細胞/組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的特徵，但也容易被誤判為 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Numerous small-to-medium CD3-positive T cells with strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining
T cells densely populate the aggregate and extend into the surrounding tissue
Interspersed CD3-negative cells with larger oval vesicular nuclei (histiocytes and occasional large atypical cells)
Slightly irregular T-cell nuclear contours without obvious large atypical T cells
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD3 highlights numerous small-to-medium T cells densely populating the lymphohistiocytic aggregate and extending into the adjacent marrow. Interspersed CD3-negative cells with larger oval vesicular nuclei correspond to histiocytes and the scattered large atypical cells. The abundant T-cell background raises the possibility of a T-cell lymphoma; however, the T cells lack obvious cytologic atypia here, and the large atypical cells are B cells (CD20+/OCT2+), consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PTCL shows atypical CD3+ T cells with antigen loss (CD5, CD7) and clonal TCR rearrangement rather than bland T cells surrounding rare large B cells.
AITL T cells co-express TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13, ICOS) with expanded CD21+ follicular dendritic meshworks and EBV+ B blasts.
Reactive aggregates are small, well-circumscribed, and lack atypical large CD20+ B cells.
